plugin.plugin_amp.name: AMP Game Servers
plugin.plugin_amp.description: AMP (CubeCoders) in Discord: log in with a button, list your game servers with state and players, start, stop and restart them, take backups, change settings and create new servers from deployment templates.
plugin.plugin_amp.node.login.label: AMP: login panel
plugin.plugin_amp.node.login.description: Shows the AMP connection with the buttons "Log in to AMP" and "Log out" (managers only, private).
plugin.plugin_amp.node.servers.label: AMP: list game servers
plugin.plugin_amp.node.servers.descripti: Lists the shared game servers with state and players.
plugin.plugin_amp.node.info.config.serve: Game server (name or ID; empty: the only one)
plugin.plugin_amp.node.info.label: AMP: game server info
plugin.plugin_amp.node.info.description: State, uptime, CPU, memory, players and address of a game server; managers get control buttons.
plugin.plugin_amp.node.power.config.acti: Action: start, stop, restart, kill or update
plugin.plugin_amp.node.power.label: AMP: start / stop / restart
plugin.plugin_amp.node.power.description: Starts, stops, restarts, kills or updates a game server (managers only).
plugin.plugin_amp.node.backup.label: AMP: backup
plugin.plugin_amp.node.backup.descriptio: Starts a backup of a game server (managers only).
plugin.plugin_amp.node.create.config.tem: Template (name or number; empty: the only one)
plugin.plugin_amp.node.create.label: AMP: create game server
plugin.plugin_amp.node.create.descriptio: Creates a game server from a deployment template of the AMP controller (managers only).
plugin.plugin_amp.node.settings.label: AMP: game server settings
plugin.plugin_amp.node.settings.descript: Lists settings that match a search, or sets one to a value (managers only).
plugin.plugin_amp.setting.managers: Who may log in and control the servers
plugin.plugin_amp.setting.managers_hint: Log in, start, stop, restart, backups, settings and creating servers. Everyone may list servers and see their info.
plugin.plugin_amp.setting.instances_hint: Loaded from AMP after the login and every 15 minutes. Check up to 25; the option "server" of the commands lists them. None checked: all are visible.
plugin.plugin_amp.setting.templates_hint: Deployment templates of the AMP controller (AMP editions with templates). None checked: creating servers is off.
